superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: SEPA's last reception is 58 min old [F2], while citizen sensors reported 18 min ago [F10]. So the NO2 maximum of 89 at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6], which moved from 77 [F7], is the newest official reading, but it may no longer be current. I have no baseline for this hour [F49], so I read that as a change between labelled hours, not as a rise. I also won't link it to the Tanjug collision [F13], because its place and time are unverified, and the parking display going from 400 to 0 [F12] is a value without an age [F11].
